seed: With nothing picked the panel is about the clip under the playhead. While a video plays past clips the panel holds the clip it showed when play started (building its sections afresh at every crossing held the window up to 14 ms a time on the 6 minute reference edit), and the moment play stops it comes up to the clip stopped on. The 6 minute reference edit opens at Next defaults, the playhead goes to three quarters (4:30, on a take, a second before B-roll 6 comes in at 4:31.2), and three seconds of play end inside the B-roll: the panel must be on the B-roll.
